row.proto: void Game_Teleport_Vehicle(void *car, const char *name, float *prev_mtx, float *new_mtx, float dt, uint32_t flags)
row.notes: Car teleport internal (immediate path; wrapped by Game_Teleport_VehicleImmediate_Thunk, 7 direct callers incl. 0x142d68cec InGamePQ, 0x142f347aa, 0x142f63f4b, 0x1437ac96b, 0x144606c14, 0x1446445ec). Args (car, tag, prev_mtx, mtx, dt, flags). Flags: bit 0x800 clear -> car+0x9f08 = 1 (the wrapper then posts the placement message), bit 12 -> car+0x9f09; flags&3 with dt > 1/30 s adds 0x40 (no velocity carry). Sets the physics actor pose ([[car+0x558]+0x340]+0x18 via 0x1440c17c0 / 0x1440c2290 / 0x1440c2080) from the two matrices and advances each wheel's spin angle by dt * rate (+0x188) modulo 2*pi (0x40c90fdb). (used by vmknolle practice-start, race-start grid placement) | merged note: teleportInternal (log VEHICLE_TELEPORT); matrix at [car+0x558]+0x190; flags 0x40 ZeroVelocity, 0x80 FadeVelocityToZero, 0x01|0x02 implicit velocity, 0x04 wheel rates, 0x08 transmission, 0x10 steering, 0x20 suspension (0x3f ImplicitAll), 0x800 Includes-Progress (no actual teleport, car+0x9f08 = 0), bit 12 -> car+0x9f09; zero translation row implies ZeroVelocity. Callers: OSQTeleportToStart (0x800), VehiclePlacementSystem (0x8540, same matrix twice), FeaturedEventSystem (0x1003f), DataSet (0x40), Reset Vehicle. (used by the vmknolle addons practice-start)
